about_the_game:
Sound of Horses is a story-driven multi-part horseback adventure that begins in the peaceful Homeland and slowly leads into something deeper.

Create your own rider and horse, explore open landscapes full of everyday life and quiet mysteries, meet memorable characters, and take on challenges that shape the early steps of your story.

The Early Access version includes Episode 1: Homeland, where daily life on horseback gradually gives way to the first threads of an unfolding mystery. The story builds toward a surprising cliffhanger, opening the way to Episode 2: The Forest Guard, where the journey begins to cross into the Other Side—a parallel world shaped by forgotten secrets and ancient forces.

From that point on, your story will move between two worlds: the familiar routines of Homeland and the strange, shifting paths of what lies beyond. Even as you’re drawn deeper into the unknown, life in Homeland continues—asking for your time, your choices, and your care.

Along the way, you’ll uncover the unique horse cultures of each region—each with their own traditions, breeds, and competitions.

Planned episodes:

  • Episode 1 – Homeland
    Begin your story in the quiet Homeland, where daily life on horseback slowly gives way to something unexpected.

  • Episode 2 – The Forest Guard
    From deep forests to snow-covered mountains, uncover the way of the Forest Guards and the secrets they protect.

  • Episode 3 – The Mystery of Draconia
    Solve riddles and take part in ancient competitions in a land shaped by old legends.

  • Episode 4 – The Land of the Eagle
    Train with the people of the Steppe and face a final test of strength, trust, and skill against the legendary Eagle.

  • Episode 5 – Fire and Ice
    Explore Volcania, a land of burning lava and frozen peaks, where the final mysteries await.

With a focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and a meaningful riding experience, Sound of Horses invites players of all ages to step into a gentle but growing adventure—one ride at a time.

Wishlist now and join the journey—the adventure is about to begin.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Athlon II (K10) 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Athlon II (K10) 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660, Intel Iris Xe, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card

short_description: Sound of Horses: The beginning of an unexpected journey from the peaceful Homeland into a world of hidden truths and distant echoes of something greater. Create your own rider and horse, explore an open world on horseback, and take your first steps into the adventure with Episode 1: Homeland.
